svg.title: Abdulrehman Ajmal: Ships products, runs a homelab, reads about rockets
svg.desc: A teal rack unit labelled Abdulrehman Ajmal, with a small black mini PC standing in a bay on its right, above a patch panel whose ports are labelled with the tools he works with. frontend: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Ionic; backend: Python, Django, FastAPI, Hasura; data and ai: PostgreSQL, GraphQL, Redis, LLM agents; infrastructure: Docker, Linux, Traefik, Dokploy.
